description: Use this when the user wants to fit a speech into a target duration. With a target duration and speed, returns how many words to write. With a script and target duration, returns the necessary speed plus words to cut or add at the selected pace. Target duration is 1 second to 24 hours and speed is a whole number from 60 to 300 words per minute. Numeric pause cues accept whole seconds from 1 to 86,400 per cue. Does not rewrite the script.

script.description: Optional existing script to assess, e.g. Welcome everyone. Thank you for coming.

speed.description: Named writing pace or whole number from 60 to 300 wpm for the word target or cut/add estimate, e.g. conversational.

target_duration_seconds.description: Target total duration in seconds, e.g. 300 for five minutes.

name: plan_script_length
title: Plan script length
